source.text: ወ*ካልእት፡ ርኢኩ፡ በእንተ፡ መብረቅ፡ እፎ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ እምከዋክብት፡ ወይከውን፡ መብረቅ፡ ወኢይክል፡ ኀዲገ፡ ምስሎሙ።
source.note: Entire selected chapter is one unit, beginning at XLIV on printed84 and ending in the first body word on printed85 before XLV. Actual editorial star retained and raised apparatus numbers excluded. Selected እፎ and plural ይቀውሙ replace prior modern transcription errors; subsequent becomes/cannot remain singular, and the last noun retains its plural possessive suffix. The number transition and its compressed reference are preserved, not harmonized or explained by supplying an unstated subject. LOW qualifies that selected-edition relation, not unread fidels or a newly collated manuscript.

transcription_uncertainties.detail: The plural rising predicate and following singular predicates are positively read, not uncertain glyphs. Their compressed reference is left open in the bounded English and mandatory explanation; neither explicit stars as the rising subject nor new before form is supplied. No manuscript reconstruction or source-number normalization is claimed.

translation.text: And I saw something else concerning lightning:[a] how they arise from the stars, and it becomes lightning and cannot leave their form.[b]

footnotes.text: The selected edition marks ካልእት with an editorial star. That marked form is retained; something else does not insert a new kind of lightning or a list of stars. The chapter contains a single unit, continued across the page break.

The selected rising verb ይቀውሙ is plural, they arise; the following becomes and cannot predicates are singular. The final printed ምስሎሙ is the noun form with a plural possessive suffix, their form, not the preposition with them. These number forms are retained without making the stars an explicit rising subject, adding new before form, or assigning an unprinted antecedent. The relation remains compressed and interpretively uncertain in the selected text; this deliberately literal treatment does not harmonize it. The selected እፎ means how, and ኀዲገ is retained as the leave-infinitive, not normalized to the apparatus form.
